skill.summary: Identifies and validates untapped niches using multi-platform live data, scoring demand, competition, and monetization to create go-to-market strategies with...

latestVersion.changelog:
v1.0.0 — Initial release with comprehensive multi-platform niche research and validation.

- Simultaneously deploys 10 Apify scrapers across major platforms (Reddit, Google Trends, Amazon, Etsy, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Twitter, Google Search, niche forums) for thorough niche discovery.
- Scores each potential niche using a proprietary 5-dimension opportunity model based on real, live data.
- Reverse-engineers the competitive landscape to identify gaps where no dominant solution exists.
- Automatically generates a tailored go-to-market strategy for each qualified niche opportunity.
- Sets up an automated audience acquisition workflow via GetResponse for immediate lead generation and nurturing.
